result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by faded crosswalk markings and significant sidewalk obstructions from an adjacent auto repair business. The lack of dedicated pedestrian signals and poor pavement quality create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Loose tires and parked vehicles from the auto repair shop block the pedestrian right-of-way.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground near the auto repair shop entrance

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are severely worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt and concrete surfaces create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and sidewalk area

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection, improving sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a wide, car-centric roadway serving a commercial plaza. While a sidewalk exists on one side, the lack of marked crossings, faded lane markings, and poor pavement quality create significant safety risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk at a major commercial entrance increases risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.

hazards.name: Faded Lane Markings
hazards.description: Worn pavement markings reduce driver guidance and predictability.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Quality
hazards.description: Visible cracking and degradation of the road surface can create trip hazards or affect vehicle control.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way at the plaza entrance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads to the existing traffic signal infrastructure to provide safe crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing and Restriping
interventions.description: Repair the degraded pavement and apply high-contrast lane markings to improve overall traffic safety and predictability.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals despite being a signalized crossing. The environment is heavily vehicle-oriented with narrow sidewalks that are further constrained by utility poles.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Inaccessible Curbs
hazards.description: Lack of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility aids, strollers, or luggage.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the middle of narrow sidewalks, reducing the effective walking width and creating obstacles.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk along the right side of the image

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all four corners of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is significantly compromised by a large vehicle parked directly within the marked crosswalk, obstructing both the path and sightlines. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals exist, the faded markings and lack of dedicated pedestrian signals create a high-risk crossing.

hazards.name: Vehicle blocking crosswalk
hazards.description: A white pickup truck is stopped or parked directly over the crosswalk markings, forcing pedestrians into the intersection and blocking visibility.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, occupying the marked crossing area.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The ladder-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal pole on the corner.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to physically prevent vehicles from parking in the crosswalk and to shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.
